headline: Former army member among 6 arrested as police rescue kidnapped shopkeeper
summary: A man kidnapped by fraudsters posing as SRB officers was rescued from Teknaf, Cox's Bazar, while six suspects including a former soldier were detained.
details: Police have rescued Md. Ehsan, also known as Hasan, a 36-year-old shopkeeper from Banshkhali, Chattogram, who was kidnapped from his hardware store in Prembazar.
caption:
A shopkeeper was kidnapped by men posing as SRB officers after being handcuffed. Now, he's safe.

Police have rescued Md. Ehsan, also known as Hasan, a 36-year-old shopkeeper from Banshkhali, Chattogram, who was kidnapped from his hardware store in Prembazar.

#Bangladesh #CrimeNews #PoliceRescue #CoxsBazar #Banshkhali

Source: Prothom Alo
tweet: Police rescue kidnapped shopkeeper from Teknaf, Cox's Bazar. Six suspects, including a former army member, were arrested for the kidnapping and demanding 20 lakh BDT ransom. #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #PoliceRescue

headline: Tourists urged to leave as Sajek road blockade resumes
summary: The 'Sajek Mass Rights Protection Committee' and 'Sajek Karbari Association' have called for an indefinite road blockade starting Thursday morning.
details: The 'Sajek Mass Rights Protection Committee' and 'Sajek Karbari Association' have called for an indefinite road blockade on the Sajek tourism road in Rangamati starting Thursday morning, October 22.
caption:
Tourists are being urged to leave Sajek as an indefinite road blockade begins today.

The 'Sajek Mass Rights Protection Committee' and 'Sajek Karbari Association' have called for an indefinite road blockade on the Sajek tourism road in Rangamati starting Thursday morning, October 22.

#Sajek #Rangamati #TravelAlert #Bangladesh #Tourism

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
tweet: Tourists are being urged to leave Sajek as an indefinite road blockade begins today. The blockade is over demands for the removal of armed members of the JSS Sant group. #Sajek #TravelAlert #Bangladesh
